title: A class series that has study guide files (source file, not published)
description: data/study/<series>/series.json: which catalog series the directory's chapter files are written from.

catalogSeriesId.description: The ':N' id of the series' '#' heading in classes.txt.

translation.description: Where the English of the passages' phrases comes from, in a sentence.

publishedTranslation.description: A published translation the phrases' English is taken from, verbatim. Only with it may a phrase have `en` without the class `audio` it was said in. No series uses it today: phrases carry the teacher's own rendering from the class.

source.description: Where it is published (a URL, or a book and edition).

chapterLectures.description: Lectures that discuss a chapter but that neither the catalog nor an alignment ties to it (a series introduction, say). Chapter key -> lecture ids. `yarn study-dump` adds them to the chapter's classes.
